content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, creating a significant barrier for many creators. PayPal, while more widespread, can suspend accounts unexpectedly, potentially freezing funds for up to 180 days without recourse. Gumroad and similar services also impose geographical restrictions, leaving creators in regions like Africa and parts of Asia without viable solutions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, provides a comprehensive solution without these geographical limitations. It enables creators to set up their own online stores with automatic crypto payment processing and full data ownership, ensuring that they are not reliant on third-party platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal typically exclude countries based on regulatory environments and risk assessments, which can leave many creators unable to access their services. This exclusion is often rooted in the companies' need to maintain compliance and manage fraud risk, but it places a heavy burden on those in restricted regions. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be inclusive, allowing creators in any part of the world to build their own digital commerce stacks. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, creators can bypass traditional restrictions, ensuring they can offer their products globally without being hindered by geographic limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal often impose high transaction fees and lengthy processing times, especially when dealing with international transactions. Stripe's fees can accumulate, particularly for small transactions, and PayPal's account holds can create cash flow issues for creators. In contrast, using NOWPayments integrated with a sovereign commerce stack typically incurs only a 0.5% transaction fee on crypto payments. This setup not only speeds up the payment confirmation process due to on-chain verification but also reduces unnecessary costs, making it a financially smarter option for creators selling digital products like presets.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators worldwide.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most critical aspects of operating an online store is ownership over your digital products and customer data. Stripe and PayPal retain significant control over your transactions and customer interactions, which can disrupt your business continuity. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, allows full ownership of both your data and products. Once deployed, creators maintain complete autonomy, supported by automated systems for payment processing and product delivery, ensuring a seamless experience for both creators and customers.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're situated in a country with Stripe or PayPal restrictions, the choice is clear: opt for sovereign commerce infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack, available for $197, can be deployed in just 48 hours, providing a robust solution tailored for digital creators. This stack includes everything you need, from hosting to payment processing, all while ensuring that you own your data and products. By choosing this architecture, you're effectively removing reliance on platforms that exclude you and embracing a model that empowers your business.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Eliminate reliance on platforms that restrict access.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by assessing your digital product offerings and market needs. Next, sign up for the Edge Commerce Stack to set up your store within 48 hours. Deploy your website using Cloudflare Pages, and implement payment processing with NOWPayments. Load your products into the system and configure your order fulfillment. Finally, promote your store to your audience and start selling directly.
